snippet.title: Important People of History: Presidents - teaser trailer (Jefferson, Washington, Lincoln)
snippet.description:
Introducing the first-ever video game biographies for Thomas Jefferson, George Washington, and Abraham Lincoln.  Learn about these luminaries and their eras via rare photos of the places where they literally made history - as these places look today, such as:
-The room where the Declaration of Independence was signed
-Revolutionary War battlefields
-Civil War battlefields
-Ford's Theatre where Lincoln was shot
-The homes where these men lived
-And much more

All three games will arrive in 2026 to coincide with the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776.

Wishlist the "Important People of History" video games today on Steam:
-Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721830/Important_People_of_History_Presidents__Thomas_Jefferson
-Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721820/Important_People_of_History_Presidents__George_Washington
-Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721840/Important_People_of_History_Presidents__Abraham_Lincoln

Follow Sunny Demeanor Games on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SunnyDemeanorGames
